description: This file contains the implementation of the RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl class, which is a final class used to build responses for RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand objects in a live query context. It includes methods for creating response objects and error responses related to attribute retrieval, and internally defines a ResponseFactory class to produce specific response types.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing a builder pattern for creating responses to RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand, including success and error responses.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: An inner class implementing ResponseFactory to produce specific response objects for successful attribute retrieval and attribute access errors.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method for creating a new instance of RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl.

methods.description: Overrides a method to create a CommandResponse using a provided creation function and the internal ResponseFactory.

methods.description: Creates a successful RetrieveAttributeResponse with the specified attribute value.
